name: runreal unreal-mcp
summary: Community MCP server for Unreal Engine that uses the built-in Python remote execution protocol, so no extra UE plugin is needed.
description: Not an official Unreal Engine project. Requires the Python Editor Script Plugin; verified by the authors on UE 5.4+. Agents get full access to the Editor. MIT per the repo LICENSE file and npm `@runreal/unreal-mcp` 0.1.4. Last commit 2025-06-06 (inactive, not marked deprecated).

agent_access.notes: Local stdio server driving Unreal Editor.
